card.situation:
Combined Synopsis/Solicitation from NPS/DOI for landscaping and vegetation maintenance services at Virgin Islands National Park (VIIS), including roadside clearing, debris removal, and drainage/waterway cleaning on a quarterly schedule.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561730 matches exactly and the firm is eligible under the Total Small Business set-aside, but the place of performance is ~2,400 miles from Oklahoma City — a fatal violation of the firm's 200-mile bid radius rule.
reasons_for: NAICS 561730 is an exact match and the firm is self-certified in SAM, satisfying the primary eligibility threshold [e1d2da67-e09c4859-p3-edcd24b8].

Grounds maintenance past performance (mowing, trimming, landscaping) at Tinker AFB provides a directly relevant technical foundation for the vegetation maintenance scope [e1d2da67-eeb2285d-p3-dfa81c6e].
The firm qualifies under the Total Small Business set-aside and has active federal references (GSA, DoD, VA) available to serve as client points of contact [e1d2da67-e09c4859-p4-c4db91ee].
reasons_against: FATAL: Virgin Islands National Park is ~2,400+ miles from Oklahoma City, far exceeding the firm's 200-mile bid radius owner rule, making performance operationally infeasible [e1d2da67-eeb2285d-p2-b0342ea7].

Pre-mobilization site verification and quarterly on-site mobilizations to the USVI are required by the SOW but the firm has no documented Virgin Islands presence, local workforce, or equipment transport capability [e1d2da67-eeb2285d-p2-264c3aad].

The base period duration is not confirmed; if under 12 months, the contract would violate the rc-base owner rule, and the firm has no tropical/island vegetation, drainage, or waterway clearing experience required by the core scope [e1d2da67-e09c4859-p10-56b28143].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, certified under NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services) and 561720. We are an eligible participant under Total Small Business set-aside solicitations and maintain an active federal contracting posture with GSA, the Department of Defense, and the Department of Veterans Affairs.

Our grounds maintenance experience includes mowing, trimming, landscaping, and irrigation services performed at Tinker Air Force Base (72 ABW) — a controlled-access federal installation — where we managed cantonment area vegetation in compliance with DoD standards and base access protocols. We have also delivered custodial and housekeeping support services at the Oklahoma City Federal Building (GSA Region 7) and a VA outpatient clinic, demonstrating consistent performance across multiple federal agencies.

Our quality assurance program includes OSHA 30-certified supervisors, CIMS-GB certification, and QC inspections logged in a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). We are enrolled in e-Verify and have completed representations and certifications — including NAICS 561730 self-certification — in SAM.gov. We have active federal references available from GSA Region 7, Tinker AFB 72 ABW, and the VA Oklahoma City Health Care System.

Red Cedar Facility Services is committed to delivering compliant, well-documented grounds maintenance services in accordance with NPS requirements and accepted industry standards for solicitation 140P5426Q0038.
